title: AiEvidenceArtifactV2
description: The self-contained AI evidence artifact, version 2: one file (*.ai-evidence.json, media type application/vnd.sigill.ai-evidence+json) carrying the v2 envelope and the JAdES signature over it. The wrapper is deliberately trivial — verification is JCS(envelope) hashing to sigD.hashV[0], then standard ETSI TS 119 182-1 validation with the caller supplying content objects for hashV[1..n]. A validator that only understands TS 119 182-1 can verify the 'signature' member directly, given the canonical envelope bytes as object 0. See ai-evidence-envelope-v2.md §6–§7.

envelope.description: The v2 evidence envelope — the signed metadata document (detached object 0 of the signature's sigD).

signature.description: A JAdES signature in General JWS JSON Serialization (RFC 7515 §7.2.1). The JWS Payload is detached and, under sigD mechanism ObjectIdByURIHash, contributes as an empty stream — hence no 'payload' member (forbidden by additionalProperties). signatures[0] is the classical signer; an optional second entry is the ML-DSA-87 hybrid signer. Each entry carries its own protected header with its own sigD (ETSI TS 119 182-1 §5.2.8.1 NOTE 1).

protected.description: base64url-encoded JWS Protected Header (alg, iat, certificate reference, crit ['sigD','b64'], b64:false, sigD).

header.description: JWS Unprotected Header. Carries 'etsiU' (sigTst timestamp tokens, rVals revocation values) on the classical signer's entry.
